// MARK: - VALUE TYPES: How a key's value is written as text in a slide's attributes. Append-only like the keys: a value type, once published, keeps its name and meaning.

value_types.description: The lexical form of a key's value. Every key names exactly one.

TEXT.description: UTF-8 text with no control characters. Corresponds to DICOM's character string value representations (LO, SH, UT).

DATE_TIME.description: A date and time in ISO 8601 extended format, YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss, to the second, with an optional decimal fraction of one to six digits (to the microsecond), followed by a required UTC offset: Z, or +hh:mm or -hh:mm between -12:00 and +14:00. The date runs from 0001-01-01 to 9999-12-31 and must be a calendar date. A time without an offset is refused.

DECIMAL.description: A base-10 number with an optional sign, fraction and exponent, for example -0.25 or 2.5E-4.

INTEGER.description: A base-10 integer with an optional sign, for example 40.

BOOLEAN.description: The text true or the text false, in lower case.

// MARK: - IDENTITY CLASSES: Whether a key's value can identify a person. A file that marks its attributes METADATA_I2S promises that every pair identifies no individual, so an I2S key is either known to identify no one or under review; a key found to identify a person leaves I2S for the clinical metadata stream.

identity_classes.description: Whether a key's value can identify an individual.

NONE.description: The value identifies no individual: it describes the slide or the device that scanned it.

UNDER_REVIEW.description: Whether the value can identify an individual is an open question, recorded in the key's identity note. Until it is answered, a de-identifier treats the value as identifying, unless the key's PHI flag states for the file that it is not.

// MARK: - KEYS: The vocabulary. Each key is a fact fixed when the slide was scanned. Every field is present on every key, null where it does not apply, so an omission is never mistaken for a default.

keys.description: The keys a slide's I2S attributes may carry. A key's name is the attribute's key in the file.

DigitalImageIdentifier.identity_note: The DII is derived from the laboratory's accession number. Whether an accession-derived identifier identifies an individual in general is an open question for the maintainer, with research under way; for each file, its companion DigitalImageIdentifierIsPHI (DII_is_PHI) carries the answer.
DigitalImageIdentifier.description: The identifier the laboratory gave the slide when it was accessioned, carried as the digital image's identifier. I2S diverges from DICOM here: DICOM's AccessionNumber (0008,0050) identifies an imaging service request, and its Container Identifier (0040,0512) identifies the slide container; the DII is neither, so it has no DICOM keyword. Its companion DigitalImageIdentifierIsPHI (short name DII_is_PHI) tells a de-identifier whether this file's DII must be scrambled. When the DII is present and DII_is_PHI is absent, a reader and a de-identifier shall treat the DII as protected health information and scramble it.

DigitalImageIdentifierIsPHI.description: Whether this file's DigitalImageIdentifier is protected health information. true: the DII is PHI, and a de-identifier shall scramble it. false: the DII identifies no individual, and a de-identifier keeps it. Absent while the DII is present: a reader and a de-identifier shall treat the DII as PHI and scramble it, the safe default. The flag is a fact about the DII and identifies no one itself. I2S diverges from DICOM here: DICOM has no such attribute.

Manufacturer.description: Manufacturer of the scanner that produced the slide's images.

verified.title: DICOM PS3.3 2026e, C.7.5.2 Enhanced General Equipment Module

ManufacturerModelName.description: The manufacturer's model name of the scanner.

verified.title: DICOM PS3.3 2026e, C.7.5.2 Enhanced General Equipment Module

DeviceSerialNumber.identity_note: The serial number identifies one scanner. DICOM PS3.15 Annex E's Basic Application Level Confidentiality Profile removes it unless the Retain Device Identity Option is used (Table E.1-1, 2026e), and the HIPAA Safe Harbor list names "Device identifiers and serial numbers" (45 CFR 164.514(b)(2)(i)(M)); both treat a device instance as a possible link to the people it served, while neither says a scanner identifies a person. Whether it stays in I2S as identifying no individual is an open question for the maintainer (research read 2026-11-24).
DeviceSerialNumber.description: The manufacturer's serial number of the scanner.

verified.title: DICOM PS3.3 2026e, C.7.5.2 Enhanced General Equipment Module

SoftwareVersions.description: The manufacturer's designations of the scanner's software versions; one value per software component.

verified.title: DICOM PS3.3 2026e, C.7.5.1 General Equipment Module

UniqueDeviceIdentifier.identity_note: Its device identifier part names a model, shared by every unit, but its production identifier part may carry the unit's serial number (21 CFR 830.3). DICOM PS3.15 Annex E's Basic Application Level Confidentiality Profile removes it unless the Retain Device Identity Option is used (Table E.1-1, 2026e), and the HIPAA Safe Harbor list names "Device identifiers and serial numbers" (45 CFR 164.514(b)(2)(i)(M)); both treat a device instance as a possible link to the people it served, while neither says a scanner identifies a person. Whether it stays in I2S as identifying no individual is an open question for the maintainer (research read 2026-11-24).
UniqueDeviceIdentifier.description: The scanner's Unique Device Identifier, in the Human Readable Form its issuing agency defines. DICOM records it as the Unique Device Identifier of each item of the General Equipment Module's UDI Sequence, one item per issuing agency; I2S carries one value per item.
